description: This file defines the PatientIdentifier class, which models identifiers associated with patients in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes fields for the identifier string, its type, location, and related patient and program information. The class provides methods for comparison, cloning, and data access.

classes.name: PatientIdentifier
classes.description: Represents a unique identifier for a patient, including its type, location, and related program info. Supports comparison, cloning, and detailed identifier data management.
